name: Pipe Spool Fabrication — Shop

activities: dimensional control of spool against isometric

typical_relationships.reason: no fabrication can begin without an issued-for-construction isometric
welding uncertified/untraceable material breaks material control
root gap, alignment and prep are verified before the joint is welded
the weld must exist before inspection
you do not heat-treat or paint over a weld that may still be repaired and re-inspected
only an accepted, dimensionally-checked spool is released to site
coating applied after heat treatment so it is not burned off

interfaces.requirement: released spools feed field erection; a spool cannot be erected before it is fabricated and QC-released
shared shop capacity and QC regime; field-fit spools complement shop spools
spools connecting to equipment nozzles must match as-set positions; nozzle-match spools may be held for field fit

testing_requirements: Shop NDT (VT + RT/UT/PT/MT) per spec with weld map and traceability
PWHT charts and hardness where required
Fit-up and dimensional inspection against isometric
commissioning_dependencies: Deliverable is a QC-released spool — the gate is 'release for delivery', not field commissioning
Shop welds must be accepted so the later field hydrotest (covering shop + field welds) is valid
typical_exceptions: Field-fit / closure spools deliberately left long and trimmed at site to as-built dimensions
Small-bore assemblies fabricated at site rather than in the shop
Tie-in / nozzle-match spools fabricated after the connecting equipment is set
evidence: Spools were cut and welded only from isometrics issued-for-construction with traceable material, and every shop weld was NDT-accepted (and PWHT'd where required) before the spool was coated and released for delivery to site.
